name: Microsoft Xbox Series S
significance: Democratized ninth-generation high-speed SSD load times and next-gen CPU architectures at an entry-level $299 price point.

verifiedFactualData.cpu: Custom 8-core AMD Zen 2 @ 3.6 GHz (3.4 GHz with SMT)
verifiedFactualData.gpuOrVideoChip: Custom AMD RDNA 2 (4.0 TFLOPS, 20 CUs @ 1.565 GHz)
verifiedFactualData.ram: 10 GB GDDR6 (8 GB @ 224 GB/s, 2 GB @ 56 GB/s)

editorialContent.overview: The smallest and most accessible next-gen console in Xbox history, delivering fast NVMe SSD loading and ray tracing in an all-digital form-factor.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Democratized ninth-generation high-speed SSD load times and next-gen CPU architectures at an entry-level $299 price point.
